summary: Amazon.com filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a $17.5 billion senior unsecured delayed draw term loan credit facility (DDTL) with Citibank as administrative agent. The facility is available until September 30, 2026, with a three-year maturity from borrowing date. Optional prepayment is permitted without penalty. Interest is based on Alternate Base Rate or Term SOFR plus margins. No special-situation catalyst such as M&A or activist. This is a routine capital markets financing, not a special situation.
